input.quote: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets, and in material respects exceeds, our preferred warranty position, so no redline is warranted. 19.1 warrants Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel and that Services and Deliverables will materially conform to their documentation and specifications; 19.2 gives Deliverables a ninety-day conformance period and warrants the hosted software Services (the defined "Services" expressly include hosted software) conform throughout the subscription term, which is longer than the 12-month software / 90-day services preferred durations. 19.3 adds no-malicious-code and Applicable Law compliance warranties. 19.4 supplies the full remedy stack — prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, and termination with refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure — and is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The 19.5 disclaimer does not swallow the express warranties: it is limited to implied warranties and states that no disclaimer limits an express warranty or remedy provided here. Minor points noted only for the record, not flagged: the malicious-code warranty is qualified to code "intentionally introduced by Vendor," and 19.1's professional-services warranty states no fixed duration (which operates in our favour).
